research_summary.paragraph: USS Plunger (SS-2) was an Adder Class submarine torpedo boat laid down on 21 May 1901 at Crescent Shipyard, Elizabethport, N.J. She was launched on 1 February 1902 and commissioned on 19 September 1903. On 25 August 1905, President Theodore Roosevelt dove aboard the vessel off Long Island Sound, spending three hours underwater. The submarine was renamed USS A-1 on 17 November 1911 and was struck from the Naval Register on 24 February 1913. After being designated Target E on 29 August 1916, she was sold for scrapping on 26 January 1922.
